name: PMLR ICML 2025 proceedings (volume 267)
notes: ICML 2025 (42nd, Vancouver, 13-19 July 2025), PMLR v267, 3245 papers. Authoritative for ICML attributions and the venue-number-to-conference mapping: v235 = ICML 2024, v267 = ICML 2025, v286 = UAI 2025. The mapping matters because PMLR volumes are NOT venue-ordered - v286 is UAI, not ICML, which is the trap this repo's methodology note warns about. Used as a NEGATIVE check: no candidate for this batch (TurboRAG, MagicPIG, SAM-Decoding, LoongServe, MemServe, MegaScale-Infer, Fiddler, MoE-Lightning, S-LoRA, Preble, XGrammar, AIBrix, Nemotron-H, Cache-Craft) appears in v267, so none of them is ICML 2025.
